request.summary: Scaffold, redesign, and migrate the Catastrophic Events RuneLite plugin: built the POC plugin from poc-runelite-plugin.md, verified it against a real RuneLite client, redesigned the side panel to match a provided mockup, and migrated the plugin's API target from catabot-web to catabot's bot-hosted HTTP server, including an events-disappearing bug fix on both sides.
request.raw_requirements: RuneLite plugin POC: scaffolded the Catastrophic Events RuneLite plugin from poc-runelite-plugin.md (config, poll loop, side panel, signup, reminders, Discord deep-link), verified it compiles and runs against a real RuneLite client (JDK 11 + Gradle wrapper committed), then did a full visual redesign of the side panel to match a provided mockup (tabs, hero card, compact rows, custom rounded/pill buttons, live-ticking countdown), and migrated the plugin's target API from catabot-web to catabot's own HTTP server (bot now hosts /events, /signup, /checkin; website is being deprecated for this). Also fixed an events-disappearing bug (endsAt/grace-period logic) on both the website and bot sides.
